items.name: Logical-Fallacies
items.description: A flaw in reasoning that makes an argument invalid, unsound, or misleading.

items.name: grokipedia_audit
items.description: Plain, sourced citation checks of Grokipedia articles, grouped by topic and done on saved snapshots, with a reasoning check against fallacy_catalog.

items.name: t013-logical-fallacies
items.description: T013: Reasoning Depth Assessment - Logical Fallacies. A psychometric benchmark for evaluating AI agent reasoning quality using Item Response Theory (IRT) principles.

items.name: thomas-aquinas
items.description: A Kiro agent skill for classical Aristotelian-Thomistic syllogistic logic — validates arguments, detects fallacies, and reduces syllogisms to Figure 1.

items.name: health-reasoning
items.description: Claude Code skill: the reasoning standard an assistant holds in health conversations. A seven-question check on its own causal and evidential claims before stating or drafting them, plus a reference list of the fallacies that distort healthcare decisions. MIT.

items.name: elenchos
items.description: Agentic logical audit tool for dissecting claims, mapping premises, and uncovering fallacies in natural language reasoning.

items.name: cot-reasoning-auditor
items.description: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trace audit toolkit for evaluating logical coherence and detecting fallacies in reasoning models.

items.name: DebateIQ
items.description: AI-powered debate & speech fact-verification platform — detects claims and quotes in any speech, verifies them against live web sources with LLM reasoning, flags manipulation and fallacies, and scores speakers. Built for MUNs, debates, and journalism in Pakistan

items.name: SpotTheFallacy
items.description: Learn to spot 40+ logical fallacies through 120+ quick, real-world scenarios. Six practice modes, a daily 5-question challenge, instant explanations, and an offline-capable PWA. Free critical-thinking practice with no ads and no accounts. Built with React + TypeScript.
